top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently reproduced achievement with a compact and defensible Katori-Ye allocation: the neutral-atom magic-wavelength lattice clock and its realisation at the 10^-18 level. It is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes if the citation is written around the lattice. P002 is a strong prediction-plus-discovery pairing but the field is about eight years old, the pairing mechanism is unresolved and Cao and the other early experimental authors fall outside the three names, so it ranks second. A prize for either part is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur connections do not involve Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Bistritzer or Jarillo-Herrero
